description: LocalLiveRun.finish() doesn't feed the last unprocessed ring audio to the VAD (flush(ring.end) only closes an already-open utterance), so speech in the final tick is missed live. When VadStream re-anchors after skipped audio, VadSegmenter keeps its in-speech state, so an open utterance can span the gap. Also the 'Saving — processing later' degraded message set in runStt is overwritten by the next tick (flicker). Found during irl-subt-9ij.16.
title: Live run misses speech at the end and across VAD re-anchors
